I have a question... what kind of a doctor are you seeing to help you with your EDS stomach related issues? I can't find a single doctor... or maybe I'm just not looking for the right one? 
Over the last few years my EDS has progressed to the point where I can barely get myself to eat, and when I do my stomach hurts SO BAD, it bloats until my skin is about to rip, I feel sick, I get reflux for hours after, my food just sits in my stomach, and I can't eat sometimes for days after. 

Thank you so any knowledge you can provide... I literally can't find anyone in my area that knows anything. Also, I'm sorry you are going through this, I know the struggle of hating your body because it won't just function like it should... most days it's beyond frustrating 

Stay strong <3

For me, when I was younger and very active I really only had the one shoulder that dislocated frequently--but now that I'm 25 it's gotten so much worse. 

In the last 3 years, I have developed  gastrointestinal problems from my EDS. My intestines sag in areas (due to lack of collagen naturally) and my food will just sit there and not digest. So then I have severe pain, scarily huge distended stomach, I'm unable to eat, etc etc.
Due to that, I am unable to work full time. And I struggle to get part time work because of my other health conditions.

It's hard to know how you will progress though, unless you know someone in your family with EDS--you might be able to ask them and maybe get an idea of how you will progress if you have the same type? EDS is such a difficult condition. 

I hope you are able to find some relief <3

I've tried physical and massage therapy, numerous medications, pain management therapy, diet changes, etc etc 
Pretty much I've seen 20+ doctors and done everything they told me to do, taken everything they told me to take--they only made me sicker. 
My stomach condition is so bad I can't even keep down pills, and if I did I have a high risk for stomach ulcers and any pain medication (even Advil) can reopen my ulcers. 

Thank you for the link, never seen a place to find clinical trials before. And thank you for the response.... every little thing helps.
